entries.words: a large multi-storey fortified residence, including a keep; both flat and gabled roofs are supported
entries.reason: Authored supported operating range, not a definition of all keeps. Default 20 x 20 m and 15 m height is representative content. English Heritage describes Middleham keep at about 15 m high, 24 m wide, 32 m deep; that example fits the range and disproves a universal height at least as large as the footprint rule. https://www.english-heritage.org.uk/visit/places/middleham-castle/history/description/

entries.words: a tall thick defensive perimeter wall, without battlements or a wall walk
entries.reason: Authored supported operating range and defaults, not universal defensive-wall dimensions. English Heritage describes Dunstanburgh mantlet as 6.5 m high and 1.3 m thick. Thin or low walls are outside this class rather than silently substituted. https://www.english-heritage.org.uk/visit/places/dunstanburgh-castle/history/
